name: business-starter
description: Business Starter and the plugins worth having alongside it, reviewed and pinned to tested commits.

plugins.name: business-starter
plugins.description: Multi-agent business HQ for any business type: one orchestrator, 16 specialist department subagents, business-type playbooks, idea scan and founder lens, shared workspace, go/pivot/kill gates and deterministic finance scripts.

plugins.name: business-suite
plugins.description: Installs the toolkit in one go: business-starter, Anthropic's docx, xlsx, pptx and pdf skills, and context7 (live docs).

plugins.name: docx
plugins.description: Create and edit Word documents. Anthropic's docx skill only (from anthropics/skills), Apache-2.0.

plugins.name: xlsx
plugins.description: Create and edit Excel spreadsheets with working formulas. Anthropic's xlsx skill only (from anthropics/skills), Apache-2.0.

plugins.name: pptx
plugins.description: Create and edit PowerPoint decks. Anthropic's pptx skill only (from anthropics/skills), Apache-2.0.

plugins.name: pdf
plugins.description: Create, fill, merge, split and read PDFs. Anthropic's pdf skill only (from anthropics/skills), Apache-2.0.

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Upstash Context7: up-to-date library and platform docs (for example Shopify themes) pulled into the session through a hosted MCP server. MIT.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Optional, for coding work: plan-first, test-driven development and debugging skills by Jesse Vincent. Adds a rule to every session that pushes skill use, so install it per project. MIT.

plugins.name: small-business
plugins.description: Optional, once the business is running: Anthropic's operations skills for invoices, bills, cash flow, payroll prep, inbox, reviews and posting. Apache-2.0.
